- Continue and finish the existing Evergreen game as a complete, playable browser game.

## Requirements
- Build now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport no wider than 1280px); inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treated the existing Evergreen creative-building game as the project to finish.
- Added undo and item removal to complement its existing placement, movement, inventory, and save features.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added placement undo with toolbar button and Ctrl+Z; undo availability updates with saved builds.
- Added right-click removal of placed items and updated the help text and desktop control hint.
- Verified the game page loads, the loading cover completes, and the inventory contains 149 items.
- Captured a JPEG check at `/tmp/opencode/evergreen-check.jpg`.

### Active
- Review the latest screenshot and test placing, undoing, removing items, and persistence.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/evergreen-check.jpg`.
2. Run browser checks for placement, undo, right-click removal, and saved-build reload; address any issues.
3. Review git diff/status and summarize assumptions and verification when finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js world, inventory, placement, persistence, undo, and removal logic.
- `index.html`: Game interface and updated controls/help text.
- `style.css`: Game interface styling and undo-button states.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser console showed one 404 for `/favicon.ico` and WebGL performance warnings; game itself loaded, with no reported gameplay runtime error.
